credentials.name: pgp_passphrase
credentials.title: PGP key passphrase
credentials.description: Unlocks your PGP key so the app can decrypt entries while the phone is locked. EVA stores it encrypted on this phone and sends it only to this app.

tool.name: get_credential
tool.title: Get a credential
tool.description: Decrypt one password-store entry. The password and any one-time code are returned as secrets EVA can type but never shows the model.
